Aspire.Hosting.Azure.EntraId/Aspire.Hosting.EntraIdScopeOptions # Optional settings for a scope exposed by a created registration or described by an existing reference.
  DisplayName?: string # Gets the scope's title, shown on the admin consent page. Defaults to the scope's name.
  Id?: string # Gets the scope's ID as a GUID, which must stay the same across deployments. Aspire derives a stable ID when omitted.
  IsEnabled?: boolean # Gets whether clients can request the scope. Defaults to true.
  RequiresAdminConsent?: boolean # Gets whether only an administrator can consent to the scope. Defaults to false, which lets users consent.
  UserConsentDescription?: string # Gets what the scope allows, shown on the consent page for users. Defaults to the scope's description.
  UserConsentDisplayName?: string # Gets the scope's title shown on the consent page for users. Defaults to the display name.

  TokenExchangeAuthority?: string # Gets the token exchange authority URL when it differs from the application's authority.
  TokenExchangeUrl?: string # Gets the token exchange audience. Defaults to api://AzureADTokenExchange when omitted.
